messages.ja: 何かを描こうとしたわけじゃない。
messages.en: I wasn't trying to paint anything in particular.

messages.ja: いろんな感情が揺らめくまま、本能で生まれた絵。
messages.en: It was born by instinct, with feelings flickering as they were.

messages.ja: 言葉にならない気持ちがあってもいい。
messages.en: It's all right to have feelings you can't put into words.

messages.ja: そのまま、ここにいていい。
messages.en: You can stay here, just as you are.
